source_findings.finding: New project initializes Portrait setup. The installed @State name is exposed through Binding(get:{name},set:...). Clear sets name empty, clears error and requests focus. The first accepted character makes the conditional Clear button appear. The setter rejects only drafts beyond StudioDisplayName.maximumScalars, otherwise retains the raw next value. No onChange normalization path exists in ProjectNameEditor.
maximumScalars is 320. All Keep prefixes fit. newInput validation/normalization is used for canSubmit and submit, not to rewrite this typing draft.

configure replaces native text when the external binding differs from modelText. publishNativeText treats a pre-write binding/model mismatch as an external reset; otherwise it writes and immediately reads the current binding, restoring native text if readback differs. These branches require coverage with a real hosted State binding. No invalid transition through them has been reproduced.
The existing edit/rejection/reset/reconfiguration tests use synchronous closure bindings. Hosted tests cover size and disabled state, but not rapid edits into a mounted State naming draft.

regression_design.binding: Reproduces the actual boundedDraft scalar guard, raw setter and duplicate guard. The fixture starts from displayed Portrait setup and implements the same Clear state changes and conditional HStack button.
